title: Glowing train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c7243a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='nose' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd84d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff9e2c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffcf4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='46' ry='30' fill='#ffcf4a' opacity='0.16'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='34' ry='20' fill='#ffe27a' opacity='0.16'/>

  <!-- track -->
  <rect x='6' y='80' width='88' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7a6cff'/>
  <rect x='6' y='80' width='88' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b8b0ff'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='9' fill='#4a4a70'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#9a9ad8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='78' r='9' fill='#4a4a70'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#9a9ad8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='7' fill='#4a4a70'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#9a9ad8'/>

  <!-- lower body / chassis -->
  <rect x='10' y='60' width='78' height='16' rx='5' fill='#8f1f30'/>
  <rect x='10' y='60' width='78' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#b83048'/>

  <!-- boiler body -->
  <rect x='12' y='38' width='58' height='24' rx='8' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <rect x='14' y='40' width='54' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='62' y='28' width='26' height='34' rx='6' fill='#e0405a'/>
  <rect x='65' y='32' width='20' height='13' rx='4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='50' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd84d' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='18' y='26' width='12' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='16' y='22' width='16' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffd84d'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='20' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='13' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='7' rx='2.4' ry='2.2' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='44' r='5' fill='url(#nose)'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='44' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- front bumper -->
  <rect x='84' y='58' width='8' height='12' rx='4' fill='#ffd84d'/>
</svg>
